summary.en: A local-first audiobook player for your own media and authorized Bilibili sources. Build a library, shape your albums, and pick up where you left off.
summary.zh-CN: 一款本地优先的有声书播放器，支持自有媒体和获准使用的哔哩哔哩内容。整理媒体库，编辑专辑，随时继续上次的聆听。

description.en: Bring your own audio and video into editable local albums. Keep chapters in your preferred order, save bookmarks, and return to the listening position that belongs to each album.
description.zh-CN: 将自有音频和视频导入可编辑的本地专辑。按喜好排列章节、保存书签，并恢复每个专辑各自的聆听进度。

description.en: Explore Bilibili sources through an explicit provider, preview imports, and choose what becomes part of your library. Local files work without an account; online sources remain subject to the provider's access rules.
description.zh-CN: 通过专门的哔哩哔哩内容源浏览内容，预览导入结果，再决定将哪些内容加入媒体库。本地文件无需账号即可播放；在线内容仍须遵守提供方的访问规则。

description.en: BPlayer is a Flutter-based prototype. Windows is the primary verification host; Android, iOS, and macOS are development targets, not certified releases.
description.zh-CN: BPlayer 是基于 Flutter 的原型应用，主要在 Windows 上验证。Android、iOS 和 macOS 仍是开发目标，并非已完成发布验证的平台。

alt.en: BPlayer expanded desktop layout showing an album chapter list beside the now-playing controls.
alt.zh-CN: BPlayer 桌面展开布局：专辑章节列表与当前播放控件并排显示。

caption.zh-CN: 展开播放器 / 1280 × 800 逻辑像素

alt.en: BPlayer compact mobile-shaped layout showing the same album, chapter list, mini player, and bottom navigation.
alt.zh-CN: BPlayer 手机比例的紧凑布局：同一专辑的章节列表、迷你播放器和底部导航。

caption.zh-CN: 紧凑播放器 / 390 × 844 逻辑像素

status.en: Primary preview platform. Requires the complete application bundle and, where needed, the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime.
status.zh-CN: 主要预览平台。请保留完整的应用程序包；部分设备还需要安装 Microsoft Visual C++ x64 运行库。

status.en: Experimental target. Native background audio, headset, and vehicle integration still need physical-device validation.
status.zh-CN: 实验性平台。原生后台音频、耳机和车载集成仍需在实体设备上验证。

status.en: Experimental target. An unsigned IPA cannot be installed as a normal App Store app; authorized signing and provisioning are required.
status.zh-CN: 实验性平台。未签名的 IPA 无法像普通 App Store 应用一样安装，需要经过授权的签名和描述文件配置。

status.en: Experimental target. Distribution signing, notarization, and native release validation must be confirmed per package.
status.zh-CN: 实验性平台。请逐个安装包确认分发签名、公证状态及原生发布验证情况。

description.en: Import your own media, rename albums, reorder chapters, and maintain local collections independently of their source.
description.zh-CN: 导入自有媒体、重命名专辑、调整章节顺序，让本地收藏独立于内容源维护。

description.en: Per-album listening positions, bookmarks, a listening timeline, and sequential, repeat, or shuffle playback.
description.zh-CN: 每个专辑拥有独立的播放进度，支持书签、聆听时间线，以及顺序、循环和随机播放。

description.en: Save authorized audio to app-private storage and manage saved files separately from caches and original media.
description.zh-CN: 将获准保存的音频存入应用专用空间，并将已保存文件、缓存与原始媒体分开管理。

description.en: Discover and import permitted videos and collections. Preview source changes before applying them to an album.
description.zh-CN: 发现并导入获准使用的视频和合集。先预览内容源的变更，再决定是否应用到专辑。

title.zh-CN: 适应不同屏幕的播放器

description.en: Compact and desktop layouts, a separate queue, audio/video switching, and saved appearance preferences.
description.zh-CN: 支持紧凑和桌面布局、独立播放队列、音视频切换，以及可保存的外观偏好。

description.en: Choose the interface language without changing your own album names or source metadata.
description.zh-CN: 自由选择界面语言，不改变自定义专辑名称或内容源元数据。

notice.en: Personal and educational use. Respect copyright, provider terms, and content permissions. Do not download or redistribute media without permission. BPlayer is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bilibili.
notice.zh-CN: 仅供个人和学习使用。请尊重版权、提供方条款与内容授权，未经许可不得下载或重新分发媒体。BPlayer 与哔哩哔哩无隶属关系，也未获得其背书。

installation.en: Only download packages you are authorized to use. Read the signing status and installation notes for the specific build.
installation.zh-CN: 仅下载你获准使用的安装包，并阅读具体版本的签名状态和安装说明。

installation.en: For a Windows ZIP, extract the entire archive and keep the full bundle together. Close an older BPlayer instance before launching the included executable.
installation.zh-CN: 使用 Windows ZIP 时，请完整解压并保留所有文件。启动其中的可执行文件前，请先关闭旧版本的 BPlayer。

installation.en: Do not disable operating-system or company security policies to run a package. Ad-hoc and self-signed development builds are not publicly trusted releases.
installation.zh-CN: 不要为了运行安装包而关闭操作系统或公司的安全策略。临时签名和自签名开发版本并非获得公开信任的正式版本。

installation.en: Import your own audio or video to listen without a provider account. Local imports reference the original files, so moving those files makes them unavailable.
installation.zh-CN: 导入自有音频或视频后，无需内容提供方账号即可聆听。本地导入引用的是原始文件，移动这些文件会使它们无法播放。

tagline.en: One terminal. Many agents. One delivery loop.
tagline.zh-CN: 一个终端，多个代理，一条交付闭环。

summary.en: Run coding agents, reusable worktrees, an editor, diff review, and project delivery services in one terminal-native control plane for GitHub and Azure DevOps.
summary.zh-CN: 在一个终端原生控制平面中运行编码代理、可复用工作树、编辑器、差异审阅，以及面向 GitHub 与 Azure DevOps 的项目交付服务。

description.en: The whole workspace is a terminal UI, so it runs over plain SSH, inside tmux, and on headless machines without a desktop client. Projects hold tabs and split panes for coding agents, shells, the bundled editor, and the bundled Git viewer.
description.zh-CN: 整个工作空间都是终端界面，因此可以直接在 SSH、tmux 和无图形界面的机器上运行，无需桌面客户端。项目内可以打开标签页和分屏，用于编码代理、终端、内置编辑器和内置 Git 查看器。

description.en: Every agent session shows a live status mark — running, waiting for you, or done — that rolls up from the pane to the tab, worktree, and project, so one waiting agent in a background project still flags that project. Updates are event-driven rather than polled.
description.zh-CN: 每个代理会话都会显示实时状态标记：运行中、等待输入或已完成。标记会从分屏逐级汇总到标签页、工作树和项目，因此后台项目中只要有一个代理在等待，该项目就会被标记出来。状态更新由事件驱动，而非轮询。

description.en: Four background services pair a deterministic poller with a coding agent: dev implements a labeled issue and opens a linked pull request, review posts structured reviews, pr-babysitter fixes checks and conflicts until a pull request can merge, and housekeep runs local maintenance. Labels drive the lifecycle and run data stays local.
description.zh-CN: 四项后台服务各自由一个确定性轮询器搭配一个编码代理：dev 负责实现带标签的工作项并提交关联的拉取请求，review 发布结构化评审，pr-babysitter 修复检查与冲突直至可以合并，housekeep 执行本地维护。标签驱动整个生命周期，运行数据保存在本地。

description.en: zai is a preview release. It needs Python 3.10+, Git, Node.js/npm, and a supported coding-agent CLI on your machine; it does not replace them. Published measurements were taken on one Linux machine and are not a general benchmark.
description.zh-CN: zai 目前是预览版本。它需要你的机器上已安装 Python 3.10+、Git、Node.js/npm 以及受支持的编码代理 CLI，并不会替代它们。README 中的性能数据仅在一台 Linux 机器上测得，不代表通用基准。

alt.en: The zai wordmark: the Latin letters z, a, i beside the Chinese character 宰.
alt.zh-CN: zai 标识：拉丁字母 z、a、i 与汉字“宰”并排。

alt.en: The zai console Welcome screen with the new-tab app picker open.
alt.zh-CN: zai 控制台欢迎页，已打开新标签页应用选择器。

alt.en: A real-time coding-agent status hint in the zai console.
alt.zh-CN: zai 控制台中的编码代理实时状态提示。

caption.zh-CN: 编码代理实时状态提示

alt.en: The zai console showing managed worktrees shared by humans and agents.
alt.zh-CN: zai 控制台展示由人和代理共享的托管工作树。

status.en: x64 and arm64 archives. Needs Python 3.10+, Git, Node.js/npm, and a supported coding-agent CLI already installed. Tested most on Linux terminals.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 压缩包。需要事先安装 Python 3.10+、Git、Node.js/npm 以及受支持的编码代理 CLI。在 Linux 终端上测试最充分。

status.en: x64 and arm64 archives, unsigned and not notarized. macOS quarantines unsigned downloads; you must approve them yourself. Same runtime requirements as Linux.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 压缩包，未签名且未公证。macOS 会隔离未签名的下载文件，需要你自行确认放行。运行环境要求与 Linux 相同。

status.en: x64 and arm64 archives, unsigned. SmartScreen warns about unsigned executables. Use Windows Terminal or another terminal with full ANSI support; WSL also works.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 压缩包，未签名。SmartScreen 会对未签名的可执行文件发出警告。请使用 Windows Terminal 等完整支持 ANSI 的终端；WSL 同样可用。

title.zh-CN: 多个代理，一个项目 MUX

description.en: Project-based tabs and split panes host Copilot CLI, Claude Code, Pi, Codex (codex-evo), OpenCode, shells, the editor, and the Git viewer side by side. The OpenCode integration preview adds delivery services, automations, live status, session resume, packaged guidance, and managed worktrees with isolated authentication. Open it with zai opencode or zai oc; OpenCode 1.18.33+ is required. This matches zai workflows, not identical native CLI features: Copilot extensions are not interchangeable, and OpenCode lacks blocking stop hooks; shared final review and result validation still gate service completion.
description.zh-CN: 基于项目的标签页与分屏可并排承载 Copilot CLI、Claude Code、Pi、Codex（codex-evo）、OpenCode、终端、编辑器和 Git 查看器。OpenCode 集成预览支持交付服务、自动化、实时状态、会话恢复、内置指引和托管工作树，并使用独立的认证目录。通过 zai opencode 或 zai oc 打开，需要 OpenCode 1.18.33+。这是 zai 工作流层面的对齐，并非原生 CLI 功能完全相同：Copilot 扩展不能直接互换，OpenCode 也没有阻断式停止钩子；服务完成仍须通过共享的最终评审与结果校验。

title.en: Status you can see at a glance

description.en: Running, waiting, and done marks roll up from pane to tab, worktree, and project. Waiting outranks running, so the agent that needs you surfaces first.
description.zh-CN: 运行中、等待输入和已完成三种标记会从分屏逐级汇总到标签页、工作树和项目。等待优先于运行，需要你介入的代理会最先浮现。

description.en: dev, review, pr-babysitter, and housekeep each pair a deterministic poller with an agent. Every repository picks its own scope, filters, and model.
description.zh-CN: dev、review、pr-babysitter 与 housekeep 各自由确定性轮询器搭配代理。每个仓库可以自行选择范围、过滤条件和模型。

title.zh-CN: 复用工作树，而不是堆积临时目录

description.en: Humans and agents claim and release isolated checkouts through one shared registry. Released worktrees return to the pool, stale session owners are recovered, and cleanup preserves dirty or retained work.
description.zh-CN: 人和代理通过同一份登记表申领与释放隔离检出目录。释放后的工作树会回到池中，失效会话的占用可被恢复，清理时会保留未提交或明确保留的工作。

title.en: Editor and diff review, built in
title.zh-CN: 内置编辑器与差异审阅

description.en: The bundled zai-editor and zai-gitter run as rails, tabs, or standalone apps, sharing one theme file with the console.
description.zh-CN: 内置的 zai-editor 与 zai-gitter 可作为侧栏、标签页或独立应用运行，并与控制台共用同一份主题配置。

description.en: Schedule background runs hourly, daily, weekly, or by cron, and export your configs, agents, and skills as a package others can install.
description.zh-CN: 可以按小时、按天、按周或以 cron 表达式安排后台任务，并把配置、代理与技能导出为他人可安装的软件包。

title.en: Projects stay organized while agents run
title.zh-CN: 代理运行时，项目仍然井然有序

description.en: Each project keeps its own sessions, worktrees, tabs, panes, rails, services, and automation state. Switch projects without flattening every agent into one global terminal list.
description.zh-CN: 每个项目都保有自己的会话、工作树、标签页、分屏、侧栏、服务与自动化状态。切换项目时，无需把所有代理摊平成一份全局终端列表。

title.en: Measured console baseline, not a full agent setup
title.zh-CN: 实测控制台基线，而非完整代理环境

description.en: On the published Linux test machine, zai without an agent idled at about 40 MiB PSS and one process. Your chosen CLI and runtime add to that footprint. The README labels Linux baselines and native Windows GitHub Copilot app first-run observations in one shared table; it does not rank complete AI setups.
description.zh-CN: 在已公布的 Linux 测试机上，未运行代理的 zai 空闲时约占 40 MiB PSS，只有一个进程。所选 CLI 及其运行时会增加资源占用。README 在共享表格中分别标明 Linux 基线与原生 Windows GitHub Copilot 应用的首次启动观测，并不对完整 AI 编码环境排名。

notice.en: Preview software that runs coding agents against your repositories and forge accounts. Review what an agent proposes before merging it, keep credentials in your own tools, and follow your organization's policies for automated commits, reviews, and merges.
notice.zh-CN: 这是会针对你的仓库和代码托管账号运行编码代理的预览版软件。合并前请先审阅代理提交的内容，凭据请保存在你自己的工具中，并遵守所在组织关于自动提交、评审与合并的规定。

installation.en: Run one of the commands above. The installer downloads the archive for your operating system and processor, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and then runs the bundled Python package installer.
installation.zh-CN: 运行上面任意一条命令。安装脚本会下载与你的操作系统和处理器相匹配的压缩包，校验其 SHA-256 值，然后运行压缩包内附带的 Python 安装程序。

installation.en: Install Python 3.10 or newer, Git, Node.js with npm, and your coding-agent CLI first. The installer needs python3 (py -3 or python on Windows) on PATH and will stop with a message if it is missing.
installation.zh-CN: 请先安装 Python 3.10 或更高版本、Git、带 npm 的 Node.js 以及你的编码代理 CLI。安装脚本需要 PATH 中存在 python3（Windows 上为 py -3 或 python），否则会给出提示并停止。

installation.en: Prefer to read before running? Open the installer URL in a browser, or download the archive from the downloads page and verify the published SHA-256 yourself before extracting it.
installation.zh-CN: 想先看清楚再执行？可以在浏览器中打开安装脚本地址，或从下载页取得压缩包，自行核对已公布的 SHA-256 值后再解压。

installation.en: Packages are unsigned. macOS quarantines unsigned downloads and Windows SmartScreen warns about them. Do not disable operating-system or organization security policies to run a preview build.
installation.zh-CN: 安装包未签名。macOS 会隔离未签名的下载文件，Windows SmartScreen 也会发出警告。请不要为了运行预览版本而关闭操作系统或组织的安全策略。

installation.en: Open a new terminal after installing so the updated PATH applies, then run zai from any folder. To start the services in a repository, run zai config init and then zai start all.
installation.zh-CN: 安装完成后请打开新的终端，使更新后的 PATH 生效，然后在任意目录运行 zai。若要在某个仓库中启动服务，请先运行 zai config init，再运行 zai start all。

intro.en: zai, Orca, and herdr are workspaces for your choice of separately installed coding-agent CLI, not built-in coding agents. Their '+ agent' headers describe intended setups, not measured agent-inclusive totals. VS Code's fresh-profile baseline has no agent extension; GitHub Copilot app is built on Copilot CLI and its first-run tree includes SDK CLI helpers. Linux workspace baselines and Windows first-run observations use different environments and memory metrics: do not rank them together or infer a complete AI-workflow winner.
intro.zh-CN: zai、Orca 和 herdr 是配合自选、另行安装的编码代理 CLI 使用的工作空间，并不内置编码代理。表头中的“+ agent”说明这种组合方式，不表示资源观测已计入代理。VS Code 是功能更广的编辑器/IDE，其全新配置基线不含代理扩展；GitHub Copilot 应用基于 Copilot CLI，首次启动观测的进程树已包含 SDK CLI 辅助进程。Copilot 应用也提供并行工作树、定时自动化和 GitHub PR 工作流。下方 Linux 工作空间基线与原生 Windows 首次启动观测的环境和内存指标不同，不能混合排名，也不能据此判断完整 AI 工作流的优劣。

notes: VS Code Remote - SSH runs the desktop app locally and installs VS Code Server on the remote host.

Orca's public editor documentation does not describe language-server support.
Orca documents creating a worktree per task plus archive/delete cleanup; it does not describe returning released checkouts to a shared reusable pool or recovering stale session claims.

notes.en: Sources checked 2026-09-30: GitHub's official app overview confirms a desktop workspace built on Copilot CLI; the UI stack remains unverified. https://github.com/github/app/blob/f37efcac9f6563656e6bc9c49ccbdb20ddb3a856/changelog.md confirms a code editor (v1.1.21) and line numbers/syntax highlighting (v1.1.15); editor LSP remains unverified, and Copilot CLI's documented LSP tools do not establish editor LSP support. Agent-session docs describe isolated worktrees and archive/delete management; changelog v0.2.8 documents automation workspace reuse, not a verified shared claim/release pool with stale-session recovery. The PR guide verifies CI/review fixes and background agent merge. Azure DevOps Git URLs can be cloned, but a native Azure DevOps work-item-to-merge service remains unverified. Documentation findings, not signed-in tests; unknown does not mean absent. Other source links are in the benchmark report and site provenance.
notes.zh-CN: 来源核查于 2026-09-30：GitHub 官方概览确认这是基于 Copilot CLI 的桌面工作空间，UI 技术栈尚未核实。https://github.com/github/app/blob/f37efcac9f6563656e6bc9c49ccbdb20ddb3a856/changelog.md 确认代码编辑器（v1.1.21）及行号、语法高亮（v1.1.15）；编辑器 LSP 尚未核实，Copilot CLI 的 LSP 工具文档并不能证明编辑器支持 LSP。会话文档描述独立工作树及归档、删除管理；v0.2.8 记录自动化复用工作空间，但未证实共享认领/释放池及失效会话恢复。PR 指南确认修复 CI、评审问题与后台代理合并。支持克隆 Azure DevOps Git URL，但原生工作项到合并服务尚未核实。这些来自公开文档，并非登录后的实测；尚未核实不代表不存在。其他来源链接见基准报告与本站溯源记录。

notes: Linux figures measured on one machine in September 2026 with VS Code 1.139.1, Orca 1.4.216, and herdr 0.9.1. The agent-qualified headers describe working setups, but these measurements cover only the stated baselines, excluding separately installed agents.

The zai download and on-disk sizes are from the zai-cli 0.1.127 Linux x64 release archive, measured on 2026-09-29. The on-disk size excludes the coding-agent CLI, and the idle console has no agent running. These are workspace-only figures, not full AI setup totals.
herdr is a terminal multiplexer for agents; it does not include zai’s editor, diff review, language servers, or delivery services.

Measured on 2026-09-30 with app 1.1.24 on native Windows 11 Enterprise x64, using three consecutive 60-second samples of the already-open first-run page. No sign-in, repository, task, or UI interaction; the tree includes the app, WebView2, SDK CLI 1.0.90-0 helpers, and console hosts. CPU percentages use one logical core (100%).

Installed files total 488.3 MB for the app plus 151.9 MB for its provisioned SDK CLI cache, excluding shared WebView2/runtime files and user data. USS covers the root and surviving observed descendants. Summed RSS can double-count shared pages; USS is private memory, not Linux PSS. The Windows and Linux observations share columns for reference only, not a like-for-like ranking.

Two descendant processes exited during trial 2; observed child CPU is a lower bound. The changing tree is a first-run observation, not a stable signed-in workspace or active coding-task benchmark. The README links all per-trial results, methodology, and gaps.

In both product tables, '+ agent' means your choice of separately installed coding-agent CLI for zai-cli, Orca, or herdr; none includes a built-in coding agent. The headers describe intended setups, not measured complete setups: their workspace baselines exclude the chosen agent CLI/runtime. VS Code's fresh-profile baseline has no agent extension; GitHub Copilot app's first-run tree already includes SDK CLI helpers. Add the chosen CLI/runtime and any required extension to compare complete setups; matched complete-setup measurements are not available here.

title.en: General features, recorded while running 7 LLM coding sessions
title.zh-CN: 常用功能演示：同时运行 7 个 LLM 编码会话

caption.en: Tabs, split panes, the editor, diff review, and live agent status, captured while seven coding-agent sessions run side by side.
caption.zh-CN: 在七个编码代理会话并行运行时录制：标签页、分屏、编辑器、差异审阅与实时代理状态。

caption.en: Browse the built-in themes and watch the whole console restyle live.
caption.zh-CN: 浏览内置主题，实时查看整个控制台的样式变化。

tagline.en: Your terminal. Your code. More than text.
tagline.zh-CN: 你的终端，你的代码，不只是文本。

summary.en: A terminal editor for writing code, understanding its history, and seeing what you are building. Familiar shortcuts, mouse support, multi-cursor editing, browser previews, and live theme selection, in one native executable.
summary.zh-CN: 一款终端编辑器，用来写代码、理解代码的来龙去脉，并直观地看到成果。熟悉的快捷键、鼠标支持、多光标编辑、浏览器预览和实时主题切换，全部集成在一个原生可执行文件中。

description.en: Core editing needs no external editor, Node.js runtime, language server, or coding agent. Editing and workspace search run in Go, so there is no separate search tool to install. Git is optional and powers history; a browser displays previews.
description.zh-CN: 核心编辑功能不依赖外部编辑器、Node.js 运行时、语言服务器或编码代理。编辑与工作区搜索均由 Go 实现，无需另行安装搜索工具。Git 是可选项，用于提供历史记录；浏览器用于显示预览。

description.en: Add carets or select the next occurrence, edit every cursor together, and undo the whole change in one step. Quick Open, literal workspace search, in-buffer Find, a lazy file tree, transient browsing tabs, and back/forward cursor history keep files and locations within reach.
description.zh-CN: 可以添加光标或选中下一处匹配，同时编辑所有光标，并一步撤销整次修改。快速打开、工作区字面量搜索、缓冲区内查找、惰性加载的文件树、临时浏览标签页以及光标前进/后退历史，让文件和位置始终触手可及。

description.en: Git blame reads the unsaved buffer instead of stale line numbers on disk, and file history is rename-aware. Saves check for external changes and refuse detected conflicts: clean buffers reload supported text, while dirty buffers keep your edits and show the conflict.
description.zh-CN: Git blame 读取的是尚未保存的缓冲区内容，而不是磁盘上已过时的行号；文件历史可识别重命名。保存前会检查外部改动，发现冲突即拒绝写入：干净的缓冲区会重新加载受支持的文本，含有未保存修改的缓冲区则保留你的编辑并显示冲突。

description.en: It is a focused text editor, not a full IDE or a large-file viewer. Editing is limited to UTF-8 text files up to 1 MiB each, with consistent LF or CRLF line endings and no NUL bytes. Keyboard shortcuts and clipboard operations depend on terminal support; the command palette provides alternatives for intercepted shortcuts.
description.zh-CN: 它是一款专注的文本编辑器，而非完整 IDE 或大文件查看器。可编辑的文件限于单个不超过 1 MiB 的 UTF-8 文本，行尾必须统一为 LF 或 CRLF，且不能包含 NUL 字节。快捷键与剪贴板操作取决于终端支持情况；对于被终端拦截的快捷键，命令面板提供了替代入口。

alt.en: The zai wordmark: the Latin letters z, a, i beside the Chinese character 宰.
alt.zh-CN: zai 标识：拉丁字母 z、a、i 与汉字“宰”并排。

title.en: Edit in more than one place

caption.en: Navigate, select, and make changes in the terminal: add carets, edit every cursor together, and undo the whole change in one step.
caption.zh-CN: 在终端中导航、选择并修改：添加光标、同时编辑所有光标，并一步撤销整次修改。

caption.en: Read Markdown, render Mermaid diagrams, and preview HTML in the browser. Markdown previews capture unsaved edits; HTML reads saved files, so preview trusted content only.
caption.zh-CN: 阅读 Markdown、渲染 Mermaid 图表，并在浏览器中预览 HTML。Markdown 预览包含未保存的修改；HTML 读取的是已保存的文件，因此请只预览可信内容。

title.en: Find the story behind a line
title.zh-CN: 找出一行代码的来龙去脉

caption.en: See blame for the buffer you are actually editing and browse rename-aware file history. The panel sits beside your source when space allows, and uses an overlay in narrow layouts.
caption.zh-CN: 查看你正在编辑的缓冲区对应的 blame，并浏览可识别重命名的文件历史。空间足够时面板会停靠在源码旁，窗口较窄时则以浮层显示。

title.zh-CN: 把编辑器变成你的样子

caption.en: Browse themes and watch the editor change before you save your choice. Standalone and zai-hosted editors share the same per-app theme setting.
caption.zh-CN: 浏览主题并实时看到编辑器的变化，确认后再保存选择。独立运行和由 zai 承载的编辑器共用同一份按应用保存的主题设置。

status.en: x64 and arm64. A single static executable with no runtime to install. Git enables history, a browser enables previews, and language servers are optional.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 版本。单个静态可执行文件，无需安装运行时。Git 用于启用历史记录，浏览器用于预览，语言服务器为可选项。

status.en: x64 and arm64, unsigned and not notarized. macOS quarantines unsigned downloads; you must approve them yourself before the executable runs.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 版本，未签名且未公证。macOS 会隔离未签名的下载文件，需要你自行确认放行后才能运行。

status.en: x64 and arm64, unsigned. Use Windows Terminal or another terminal with full ANSI and mouse support; WSL also works. SmartScreen warns about unsigned executables.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 版本，未签名。请使用 Windows Terminal 等完整支持 ANSI 与鼠标的终端；WSL 同样可用。SmartScreen 会对未签名的可执行文件发出警告。

description.en: Add carets or select the next occurrence, edit them together, and undo the whole change in one step. Paste one line per cursor to distribute edits.
description.zh-CN: 添加光标或选中下一处匹配，同时编辑并一步撤销整次修改。粘贴时可按行分配到各个光标。

description.en: Blame uses the unsaved buffer, not stale disk line numbers. Browse rename-aware file history and look up associated pull requests with your existing authentication.
description.zh-CN: Blame 基于未保存的缓冲区，而非磁盘上已过时的行号。可浏览识别重命名的文件历史，并使用你已有的登录凭据查询相关拉取请求。

description.en: Open a browser preview without a frontend toolchain. Markdown includes unsaved edits; diagram and renderer assets are bundled for offline use.
description.zh-CN: 无需前端工具链即可打开浏览器预览。Markdown 预览包含未保存的修改；图表与渲染资源已内置，可离线使用。

description.en: Add inline comments without changing the file. Ask AI assembles your question, captured excerpts, and selection into a request you can copy to a coding agent.
description.zh-CN: 可以在不修改文件的前提下添加行内注释。Ask AI 会把你的问题、抓取的代码片段与当前选区组装成可复制给编码代理的请求。

title.en: Themes you can see before choosing

description.en: Preview themes live in Settings and save your choice. Standalone and zai-hosted editors share the same per-app theme setting.
description.zh-CN: 在设置中实时预览主题并保存选择。独立运行和由 zai 承载的编辑器共用同一份按应用保存的主题设置。

description.en: Syntax highlighting works without a language server. Install and enable supported servers explicitly for completion and go-to-definition when you need them.
description.zh-CN: 语法高亮无需语言服务器即可工作。需要补全和跳转到定义时，再显式安装并启用受支持的语言服务器。

title.en: Familiar editing without a desktop runtime
title.zh-CN: 无需桌面运行时的熟悉编辑体验

description.en: Unlike modal terminal editors, zai-editor starts with familiar VS Code-style keys, a searchable command palette, multiple cursors, Git history, and browser previews in one native terminal app.
description.zh-CN: 不同于模态终端编辑器，zai-editor 默认提供熟悉的 VS Code 风格按键、可搜索命令面板、多光标、Git 历史和浏览器预览，并全部集成在一个原生终端应用中。

title.zh-CN: 实测体积，并如实说明取舍

description.en: The published Linux comparison measured an 8.2 MiB download and about 25 MiB idle PSS: far below VS Code and a smaller download than Neovim, while micro and Microsoft Edit remain smaller and Neovim uses less memory. The evidence page records versions, method, and limits.
description.zh-CN: 已公布的 Linux 对比测得下载包为 8.2 MiB、空闲 PSS 约 25 MiB：远低于 VS Code，下载包也小于 Neovim；但 micro 与 Microsoft Edit 仍更小，Neovim 的内存占用也更低。证据页记录了版本、方法与限制。

notice.en: Preview software distributed as unsigned packages. Preview only content you trust: HTML previews can run scripts on the shared preview origin. Follow your device and organization security policies, and keep your own backups of files you edit.
notice.zh-CN: 这是以未签名安装包形式分发的预览版软件。请只预览你信任的内容：HTML 预览可能在共享的预览来源上执行脚本。请遵守设备与组织的安全策略，并为你编辑的文件自行保留备份。

installation.en: Run one of the commands above. The installer downloads the archive for your operating system and processor, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, places the executable in the .zai folder in your home directory, and updates the Windows user PATH or common macOS/Linux shell profiles.
installation.zh-CN: 运行上面任意一条命令。安装脚本会下载与你的操作系统和处理器相匹配的压缩包，校验 SHA-256 值，把可执行文件放入主目录下的 .zai 文件夹，并更新 Windows 用户 PATH 或常见的 macOS/Linux shell 配置文件。

installation.en: The macOS/Linux one-line installer requires Python 3 to read the release manifest; the installed binary does not need Python, a Go toolchain, a Node.js runtime, or zai. Git and language servers stay optional and are never installed for you.
installation.zh-CN: macOS/Linux 的一键安装脚本需要 Python 3 来读取发布清单；安装后的可执行文件不需要 Python、Go 工具链、Node.js 运行时或 zai。Git 与语言服务器始终是可选项，安装脚本不会替你安装它们。

installation.en: Prefer to read before running? Open the installer URL in a browser, or download the archive from the downloads page and verify the published SHA-256 yourself before extracting it.
installation.zh-CN: 想先看清楚再执行？可以在浏览器中打开安装脚本地址，或从下载页取得压缩包，自行核对已公布的 SHA-256 值后再解压。

installation.en: Packages are unsigned. macOS quarantines unsigned downloads and Windows SmartScreen warns about them. Do not disable operating-system or organization security policies to run a preview build.
installation.zh-CN: 安装包未签名。macOS 会隔离未签名的下载文件，Windows SmartScreen 也会发出警告。请不要为了运行预览版本而关闭操作系统或组织的安全策略。

installation.en: Open a new terminal after installing so the updated PATH applies, then run zai-editor from any folder.
installation.zh-CN: 安装完成后请打开新的终端，使更新后的 PATH 生效，然后在任意目录运行 zai-editor。

intro.en: zai-editor aims for familiar desktop-editor workflows inside a native terminal app. The tables include the README’s capability comparison and measured Linux footprint, including the places where smaller editors win.
intro.zh-CN: zai-editor 把熟悉的桌面编辑器工作流带进原生终端应用。下表包含 README 中的功能对比和 Linux 实测占用，也如实展示其他轻量编辑器更占优势的项目。

rows.label: Whole editor runs in a terminal (SSH, tmux)
Built-in Git blame and file history
Inline comments and a copyable Ask AI request

notes: VS Code Remote - SSH runs the desktop app locally and installs VS Code Server on the remote host.
micro and Edit use common keys such as Ctrl+S, Ctrl+F, and Ctrl+Z, but do not have Ctrl+P Quick Open.
Neovim's command line and micro's Ctrl+E prompt take typed commands rather than presenting searchable command lists.
Neovim ships an LSP client; each language server still needs configuration.
micro shows changed lines in a diff gutter, not Git blame.
Neovim and micro include color schemes selected by command or setting rather than a live preview picker.
VS Code previews inside its own window; zai-editor opens previews in the browser with renderer assets bundled for offline use.
Copilot Chat can use the editor selection as context and requires a GitHub account.

title.zh-CN: 与其他编辑器的资源占用对比

notes: zai-editor is much smaller than VS Code and has a smaller download and install than Neovim, but micro and Microsoft Edit are smaller still, and Neovim, micro, and Microsoft Edit use less idle memory. zai-editor bundles browser previews, Git history, themes, and a language-server client.
The zai-editor download and on-disk values are the published 0.3.1 Linux x64 release archive, measured on 2026-09-29.

VS Code’s artifact sizes preserve the benchmark’s decimal MB units; the other editors are reported in binary MiB. VS Code was measured with a folder open and no file open; each terminal editor had one small file open.
Measured on one Linux x64 WSL2 machine in September 2026. Other editors retain strengths not captured by these tables, including Neovim’s modal workflow and plugin ecosystem.

label.zh-CN: 在 GitHub 阅读完整对比、证据与方法 ↗

tagline.en: Review Git changes like a pull request.
tagline.zh-CN: 像审阅拉取请求一样审阅本地改动。

summary.en: A fast, read-only Git diff reviewer for your terminal. Side-by-side diffs, line-anchored review comments, one-key Ask AI export, and 25 built-in themes in a single small binary with no runtime to install.
summary.zh-CN: 一款快速、只读的终端 Git 差异审阅工具。并排差异、可锚定到行的审阅批注、一键 Ask AI 导出以及 25 款内置主题，全部集成在一个体积很小的二进制文件中，无需安装运行时。

description.en: Browse net working-tree changes — staged, unstaged, and untracked — or any commit, file by file, with added and deleted line totals for the workspace, folder, or file. Diffs are inline on narrow terminals and switch to side-by-side automatically once the terminal is wide enough.
description.zh-CN: 逐个文件浏览工作区的净改动（已暂存、未暂存与未跟踪），或浏览任意一次提交，并查看工作区、目录或文件层面的新增与删除行数统计。终端较窄时使用行内差异，宽度足够时会自动切换为并排差异。

description.en: Leave comments on lines or selections. Drafts keep their anchors across refreshes, and anchors that may be stale are flagged instead of silently moved. One key exports your question, your comments with file, range, and revision, and the current selection as a bounded, copy-ready prompt in which repository text is marked as untrusted data.
description.zh-CN: 可以针对某一行或某段选区留下批注。草稿在刷新后仍保留锚点；可能已失效的锚点会被标记出来，而不会被悄悄移动。一键即可把你的问题、带文件/范围/版本信息的批注以及当前选区，导出为有边界、可直接复制的提示词，其中仓库文本会被标注为不可信数据。

description.en: Viewing never writes the index or working tree and never runs external diff or textconv commands. Git actions stay behind an explicit command palette, with confirmation before anything destructive. Searchable branch and commit panels, guarded branch switching, and an all-ref graph view live in one sidebar.
description.zh-CN: 浏览过程绝不会写入索引或工作区，也不会调用外部 diff 或 textconv 命令。Git 操作全部收拢在显式的命令面板中，执行破坏性操作前会要求确认。可搜索的分支与提交面板、带保护的分支切换，以及包含全部引用的图形视图，都集中在同一个侧栏中。

description.en: It runs anywhere Git does — Windows, Linux, macOS, WSL, and SSH sessions — and needs no forge account, server, or AI agent. Comparison figures in the project README were measured on one Linux machine; other tools were not independently assessed.
description.zh-CN: 只要能运行 Git 的地方它都能运行：Windows、Linux、macOS、WSL 以及 SSH 会话，且不需要代码托管账号、服务器或 AI 代理。项目 README 中的对比数据仅在一台 Linux 机器上测得，其他工具未经独立评估。

alt.en: The zai wordmark: the Latin letters z, a, i beside the Chinese character 宰.
alt.zh-CN: zai 标识：拉丁字母 z、a、i 与汉字“宰”并排。

caption.en: Reviewing changes file by file, dragging panel borders and following commit quick links, and switching themes live without leaving the viewer.
caption.zh-CN: 逐个文件审阅改动、拖拽面板边框、跟随提交快捷链接，并在不离开查看器的情况下实时切换主题。

status.en: x64 and arm64, unsigned and not notarized. macOS quarantines unsigned downloads; you must approve them yourself before the executable runs. Git must be on PATH.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 版本，未签名且未公证。macOS 会隔离未签名的下载文件，需要你自行确认放行后才能运行。PATH 中必须能找到 Git。

status.en: x64 and arm64, unsigned. Use Windows Terminal or another terminal with full ANSI and mouse support; WSL also works, including commit quick links. SmartScreen warns about unsigned executables.
status.zh-CN: 提供 x64 与 arm64 版本，未签名。请使用 Windows Terminal 等完整支持 ANSI 与鼠标的终端；WSL 同样可用，包括提交快捷链接。SmartScreen 会对未签名的可执行文件发出警告。

installation.en: Prefer to read before running? Open the installer URL in a browser, or download the archive from the downloads page and verify the published SHA-256 yourself before extracting it.
installation.zh-CN: 想先看清楚再执行？可以在浏览器中打开安装脚本地址，或从下载页取得压缩包，自行核对已公布的 SHA-256 值后再解压。

installation.en: Packages are unsigned. macOS quarantines unsigned downloads and Windows SmartScreen warns about them. Do not disable operating-system or organization security policies to run a preview build.
installation.zh-CN: 安装包未签名。macOS 会隔离未签名的下载文件，Windows SmartScreen 也会发出警告。请不要为了运行预览版本而关闭操作系统或组织的安全策略。

installation.en: Open a new terminal after installing so the updated PATH applies, then run zai-gitter in any repository. Press F1 for commands, F2 for settings, and Ctrl+Q to quit.
installation.zh-CN: 安装完成后请打开新的终端，使更新后的 PATH 生效，然后在任意仓库中运行 zai-gitter。按 F1 打开命令面板，F2 打开设置，Ctrl+Q 退出。

intro.en: zai-gitter focuses on pull-request-style review in the terminal rather than staging or rebasing. The project README compares its review workflow with terminal Git tools and GitHub Desktop.
intro.zh-CN: zai-gitter 专注于终端中的拉取请求式审阅，而不是暂存或变基。项目 README 将其审阅工作流与终端 Git 工具及 GitHub Desktop 进行了对比。

title.zh-CN: 与终端 Git 工具对比

In-app theme picker with live preview

lazygit can render side-by-side diffs through a configured external renderer such as delta.
Other tools retain strengths not listed here, including interactive staging and rebasing.
